inlines.v: INSERT', verb transitive [Latin insero, insertum; in and sero, to thrust.] Literally, to thrust in; hence, to set in or among; as, to insert a cion in a stock; to insert a letter, word or passage in a composition; to insert an advertisement or other writing in a paper.
